decision_conditions: The extension by reason of its size, siting and depth would have an overbearing effect upon the adjoining property No. 36 Berkshire Gardens that would result in a loss of light and outlook, detrimental to the amenities of that adjoining neighbouring property, contrary to London Plan (2021) Policies D3, Core Strategy (2010) Policies CP30, Development Management Document (2014) Polices DMD8, DMD11 and DMD37 and National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

The proposed extension by reason of size, siting and design would appear bulky and incongruous, and would represent an overly dominant, incongruous and visually intrusive form of development, out of keeping and character with, and detrimental to, the appearance and character of the property and surrounding area, contrary to London Plan (2021) Policies D3, Core Strategy (2010) Policies CP30, Development Management Document (2014) Policies DMD11 and DMD37 and National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

Insufficient information within the Flood Risk Assessment has been provided to enable assessment of whether the proposed development would result in an increase in flood risk on or off site and suitable flood control and mitigation measures have not been demonstrated, this would be contrary to London Plan Policies SI 12 and SI 13, Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD59, DMD60, DMD61 and DMD62 of the Development Management Document (2014) and National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
description: Part single, part two storey rear extension.
